label: Negatives
outcome: Lo studente costruisce negative corrette scegliendo l'ausiliare richiesto dalla struttura: be + not, don't/doesn't + base form, didn't + base form e le negative dei tempi continui/perfetti già studiati quando il programma le richiede.
must_master: recognise auxiliary-led negatives in already studied continuous/perfect forms
do_not_teach_yet: systematic double-negative sociolinguistics beyond standard school English

italian_learner_risks.risk: using a past form after didn't

context_bank: what people did not do yesterday
quality_rejections: teaching all English negative constructions at once
mixing question formation as the main target
more than two near-identical transformation items in sequence
non-standard double negatives presented as target grammar
